build.beforeDevCommand: npm run icons:sync && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run icons:generate && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: A calm, local-first home for schedules, tasks, ideas and expenses.
bundle.longDescription: ChronoEon (时元) is a local-first calendar, diary and task application with SQLite storage and semantic cross-device sync.
